Dana (PM): Quick idea dump: instead of large one-off migrations we build a tiny migration SDK + telemetry opt-in that customers can embed. Goals: reduce friction, automate pin expiry safety checks, and get better post-cutover signals (quality/cost). Thoughts?

Ravi (Infra): I like the SDK. Needs to be tiny (<50KB), no new heavy deps, and work across hosted/dedicated/private. It should contain a small client that can: check catalog pin status, request a staged cutover, and report simple telemetry pings (latency, error-rate, prompt-hash + vector-signature).

Priya (ML): Telemetry opt-in is key. Suggest these signals: sample outputs (hashed, truncated), latency percentiles, embedding drift summary (mean cosine), and top-5 token perplexity proxy. Privacy note: all sampled outputs must be hashed/anonymized; no raw PII leaving customer infra for Private deployments.

Nate (Sales): From customers we've heard: they want control + audit trail. If SDK supports an "opt-in but auditable" mode (customers can see exactly what telemetry is sent) that's a huge win. Also offer a managed migration path for enterprise customers who don't want to run the SDK.

Dana (PM): Proposed pin-expiry automation flow (draft):
- When a model is marked for deprecation, create a migration artifact in the catalog with a recommended window.
- After N days by default (configurable), notify tenants and spin a staged rollout only for tenants that installed the SDK and opted-in to telemetry.
- If telemetry shows quality ~= baseline and cost <= threshold after 7 days -> auto-expire pin for those tenants.
- Otherwise keep pin active and surface a migration playbook.

Ravi (Infra): Implementation constraints: the catalog must maintain per-tenant pin metadata and a small per-tenant TTL. We can implement a lightweight webhook to the customer's SDK to trigger backfill/warmup. For Private deployments, SDK telemetry should be push OR pull (pull mode preferred for air-gapped).

Priya (ML): Decision gates I propose for auto-expiry:
- Quality gate: rolling A/B sample pass rate >= 98% vs baseline on prompt-suite (sample size min 2k)
- Embedding gate: mean cosine >= 0.88
- Cost gate: median per-token compute delta <= +10%
- Latency gate: p95 not worse than baseline p95 + 150ms
If any fail -> hold and flag for manual review.

Nate (Sales): For enterprise contracts we should allow an explicit "no-auto-expire" contract clause. Also migration credits: small one-off credits when they run the SDK migration because it lowers our manual ops.

OpsBot: Migration ticket created: infra/migrations-1712500000 id=mg-937 :white_check_mark:

Dana (PM): UX notes: SDK should include a dashboard widget that customers can enable to preview changes (sample inputs -> new-model outputs in a safe, hashed way). Also include a rollback button that calls the catalog rollback API for that tenant.

Ravi (Infra): On the rollback front, we need to guarantee cache compatibility. SDK should support a warmup API that accepts top prefixes and a rate-limited replay endpoint. We'll add a short-runbook for backfill and a throttler in the SDK.

Priya (ML): We'll provide an evaluation harness that customers can run locally (part of SDK) so they can validate before opt-in. It will run a 500-sample smoke test and output a small JSON summary (hashes + metrics). For Private, we'll publish a signed binary.

Nate (Sales): Wanted: a simple line for the sales playbook: "Embed SDK -> opt-in -> 7-day staged rollout -> possible auto-pin expiry -> migration credits." Keep messaging clear and optional.

Dana (PM): Action items:
- Ravi: prototype SDK API + warmup endpoint by next Wed
- Priya: publish eval harness and default gate thresholds by Tue
- Nate: draft one-pager for sales and legal hooks for no-auto-expire clause by Fri
- I'll draft a short product brief and internal runbook.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: product.sync 1712580000 (Fri 11am)

Dana (PM): If no objections I'll add this to roadmap as a small initiative (1 sprint prototype, then pilot). Thanks all! :rocket:
